description: Exact original static runtime desert mesh positions, triangle indices, computed normals, UVs, material values and procedural texture pixels. Both real fork roads are exported independently. Lighting, shaders and renderer differ from PlayCanvas. No gameplay/GPU capture or frame-rate claim; no driver, vehicle or downloaded asset.
renderer: Blender 4.3.2 Cycles CPU, 2 threads, 48 samples. Fixed original source-derived cameras. No gameplay/GPU or FPS claim.

normalShading.storage: Exact float32 source normal FLOAT_VECTOR POINT attribute, source (x,y,z) to Blender (x,-z,y)
normalShading.shader: Attribute Vector -> object-to-world NORMAL -> normalize -> multiply (1 - 2 * Backfacing) -> Principled BSDF Normal
normalShading.notice: Exact source normal data and two-sided transform convention; approximate offline material/light response

normalVerification.batch: Desert sandstone lane and visual coping
Desert pale keystones and contact trim
Desert deep masonry and pottery recesses

framingSource: Thirty immutable forward/chase transforms plus five pre-enrichment catalog transforms; no geometry refit

glb.note: Original static source geometry at float32 GPU precision, source UVs/normals/material values and embedded procedural textures; approximate glTF PBR response

blend.note: Editable exact source float32 positions, UVs and normal POINT attributes, explicit two-sided source-normal shader, packed procedural textures, frozen daylight and all35 original source-derived cameras

desert-overview.name: desert-overview
desert-overview.description: Complete original Sunweave Caravan circuit, connected dune ascent and wind-carved sandstone descent, both physical fork roads, two open stone arches, caravan sailcourt, beacon, kiln and waystation. Exact emitted source geometry with approximate offline light.

desert-topdown.name: desert-topdown
desert-topdown.description: True overhead source geometry with both complete physical roads: the technical Archway Weave and broad banked Sailcourt Sweep. Actual road widths, branch ownership, split/merge throats and complete connected landform are retained.

desert-driver-reveal.name: desert-driver-reveal
desert-driver-reveal.description: Blueprint driver-eye pose on the real start road at 1050 m, exactly 1.6 m above source support. The original carved sandstone shoulder and connected dune landform frame the next bend. No raised camera, hidden foreground, lowered terrain, HUD, driver or vehicle.

desert-arch-passage.name: desert-arch-passage
desert-arch-passage.description: Low approach on the actual Archway Weave, exactly 1.6 m above source road. Both genuinely open stone rings, seated piers and crown blocks, the flush through-road and daylight between arches remain unmodified. No cutaway, hidden wall or gameplay claim.

desert-caravan-detail.name: desert-caravan-detail
desert-caravan-detail.description: Nearby low perspective of the original grounded caravan sailcourt with connected timber frames, actual cloth surfaces, seated posts, rope ties and source-built detail. All scenery remains visible and unchanged; approximate offline material response.
